name: How do I choose materials for a foreclosed bathroom refresh on a budget?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose materials for a foreclosed bathroom refresh on a budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing materials on a budget involves prioritizing impact and durability. Opt for cost-effective yet durable options like vinyl plank or ceramic tile for flooring, rather than expensive natural stone. Select mid-range fixtures and vanities that offer good value and a modern look. Focus on refreshing surfaces that make the biggest visual difference, like paint and grout, to achieve a significant update without overspending. We can guide you on material selections that balance quality and cost.
